questions.q: A data set recorded for the natural exponent consists of the four values $\{16, 20, 24, 30\}$. What is the arithmetic mean? Show your complete algebraic work.
questions.answer: Final Answer: $22.5$. The sum is $16 + 20 + 24 + 30 = 90$, and dividing by $4$ gives $22.5$.
